profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Avatar Securities, LLC
profile.summary: Software developer with over 20 years of experience divided between a very large telecommunications company and 3 small to very small high-frequency trading firms, including 15+ years experience developing in C++. Led teams from software design through testing for bigger projects at Motorola and have worked in highly independent environments with very little guidance (1-3 developers) since 2008. Very interested in bioinformatics, big data, and AI. Ability to multitask, solve difficult problems, improve performance of existing software, work well within a team, and communicate effectively.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary responsibility: developing C++ trading applications on Linux in a trading environment handled by a small team of developers.

Main assignments:
-worked with a trader to write several new trading strategies for equities on top of an existing framework
-used Takion API (on Windows) to write a depth-based market handler (C++) and broadcast various signals to Linux trading applications based on market conditions
-modified an existing replay system to be able to simulate trading, in the effort to backtest a wide variety of trading parameter combinations
-wrote Python scripts to run simulations over a series of days, read the results of the simulations, and report the better results, leading to modified trading parameters for production strategies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary responsibility: developed C++ trading and price feed applications on Linux in a high-performance trading environment handled by 1-3 programmers.

Main assignments:
-ensured proper application startup in the morning
-worked with a trader to write several new trading strategies for stock and option securities
-implemented test suite for each trading application using Google Test framework for a unit test environment
-did post-trade analysis to determine effectiveness of trades 
-wrote to the PHLX/NSDQ/OMX direct depth options and Nasdaq "top of book/trade" option price feeds
-wrote to the BATS depth options/stocks feeds
-wrote to the Instinet stock price feeds
-enhanced existing ISE/GMNI/Mercury BBO feeds to become a multi-threaded application 
-developed applications to provide OPRA and stock price data to clients 
-measured and optimized performance for existing Exegy-based and OPRA price feeds
-wrote an application to measure performance for orders routed to various brokerages
-wrote to Goldman to support a FIX drop copy session
-updated and created new applications to provide market data and downloadable configuration files to other clients
-wrote scripts in Perl and Python for configuration file generation, measuring performance, etc.
-updated various backend applications (pnl service, position server, etc) as needed
-wrote news-based feed handler
-created "warm path" mechanism to achieve faster trade execution by simulation of trading events
-modified a Java application that read news feeds and made trades to C++, reducing the latency from about 10-20microseconds to 3-8microseconds

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primary responsibility: developed C++ back office and trading applications.

Main assignments:
-updated and created software applications to interface with ITG price feeds
-created data playback mechanism to back test trading applications
-updated two existing trading applications with new features
-worked closely with trader to create three new trading applications to work with stock, options, and spread data
-updated legacy gui C# applications
-created newer gui QT applications
-wrote Perl scripts to analyze trade performance
-ensured start of day files were successfully downloaded and infrastructure/trading applications were successfully started
-implemented complex orders
-updated software for proper position handling and marking
-implemented multiple strategies to examine new potential trading opportunities
-created infrastructure to handle futures options prices

positions.title: Principle Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Principal Staff Engineer, iDEN BSC Software Development Group

-Team leader for command-line User Interface and Statistics development on a Linux platform for the SR17.0 software release
-Managed the various phases of development from requirements through integration testing
-Reviewed and provided feedback for System Requirements and Architecture documents
-Periodically analyzed and provided staffing efforts for potential future features
-Led high-level architecture and requirements effort for SR15.0 release for features dealing with replacement of telnet with SSH and a feature to allow for individual user accounts to be created and managed

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
iDEN BSC Software Dev. Group (Jan 2002 - Oct 2005)

-Team Lead for command-line UI and Statistics development for the SR14.0 software release
-Managed development from requirements through integration testing
-Due to a 500x increase in statistics collected by the network element, designed and developed a new Statistics collection mechanism (C++) to capture the data more efficiently via new APIs
-Worked with Common Platform (HAP) System engineers to determine our department’s direction for handling the UI and statistics on the new VxWorks-based BSC platform (iVPU) for a major software release 
-Led software team in developing a new command-line User Interface software component. The C++ component contained multiple tasks, handled a telnet interface of up to 5 user sessions, logged all user i/o, providing various APIs available to other applications to print and log debugging information and software faults, and switching between a custom command-line interface and the VxWorks shell
-Wrote a significant portion of the original code (C++) development for the UI software 
-Provided significant input to requirements, design, and architecture of the Statistics software component
-Analyzed and resolved software issues for the User Interface software component
-Contributed substantially to the creation of a document detailing the differences between the new commands and statistics as compared to the commands and statistics available on the prior BSC platform
-Diagnosed and resolved problems (C) for the GSM BSS-designed operating system
-Provided consultation and troubleshooting expertise to GSM BSS software engineers

GSM BSS Software Dev. Group (Jan 2001 - Dec 2001)

-Consulted 3GPP Specifications to write requirements for Mobile Simulator features 
-Worked closely with engineers from Banagalore to track their work and assist with technical issues
-Designed, coded (C++), and tested software features for the Mobile Simulator

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
GSM BSS Software Dev. Group (Cork, Ireland; Apr 2000 - Dec 2000)

-Relocated to Ireland to assist in establishing a new software group and training engineers in the area of Statistics and Operations & Maintenance 
-Created and taught lab classes concentrated on testing software fixes and debugging software faults
-Resolved issues presented by non-BSS Cork engineers regarding BSS software application processes
-Managed multiple engineers by assisting them in forming their training plans, providing feedback on their work, and helping them to create and manage their goals 
-Introduced changes to the Switch Manager process that resulted in considerable efficiency gains
-Participated with other senior group members and management in assessing the progress of junior group members
-Mentored two engineers in the area of Statistics and helped them to create a roadmap of future projects

GSM BSS Software Dev. Group (Arlington Heights, IL; Dec 1998 - Apr 2000)

-Created requirements, designed, coded (C) and tested software for two features for the Switch Manager software functional area to support the addition of CS3/4 to the Motorola GPRS product 
-Led team in integration testing software changes for a software feature
-Fielded questions/issues in the area of Switch Manager for the BSS Software group and worked with -Call Processing engineers to troubleshoot and diagnose software defects
-Redesigned significant portions of the database and database-related code to create substantial memory savings

positions.title: Software Engineer I and II
positions.description:
-Made code fixes (C) for software defects, enhancements and new features in the areas of Statistics and Operations & Maintenance for the GSM BTS and BSC products
-Resolved issues (via debugging, consultation with other engineers and ETSI specifications) from other software engineers, testers, and field engineers for the Statistics functional area 
-Assisted in developing a tool to automate the code and document inspection process
-Led two Statistics-related features
-Presented at workshops (in Arlington Heights and in England) attended by other members of the organization to convey the Statistics process, as well as the addition of new statistics to the system
-Helped to design the Statistics applications to collect and manage statistics on a new network element
